sections.label: Added
items: Click any text in the color bar to copy it to the clipboard (briefly shows "Copied"). Only the text is clickable; the rest of the bar stays click-through.

sections.label: Changed
items: Rule sections (Bar Appearance, Bar Text) are now collapsible and collapsed by default, keeping expanded rules shorter.
Moved the Text / Fleet Server Info / Browser Info buttons to the top of the Bar Text section (below the mock-up) and dropped the "Add" prefix.

sections.label: Changed
items: Removed the global Display toggle; the in-rule bar mock-up is always shown.
Removed the "Saved" toast — settings auto-save silently; validation errors are still shown.

sections.label: Added
items: Global Tab indicator toggle: replaces the tab's favicon with a solid rounded tile in the matched rule's color.
The indicator only appears on background (unfocused) tabs — the active tab keeps its real favicon, so the page you're viewing is never obscured.
Follows the rule color across in-app (SPA) navigations.
Optional scope: apply the indicator to all rules or only selected ones, set in one place in the Global panel (rules stay uncluttered).

sections.label: Fixed
items: Domain Pattern with Wildcards on now matches the host as typed. Previously it silently required a subdomain, so a pattern like qa.example.com/* never matched qa.example.com itself. Add a *. prefix to include subdomains.

sections.label: Added
items: Browser Info segment for the bar text, showing the current tab's browser, full version, platform, and architecture (placeholders {browser}, {version}, {major}, {platform}, {arch}); works like the Fleet Server Info segment but reads the browser with no network request. Full version/platform/arch come from User-Agent Client Hints.

sections.label: Added
items: Create a rule for the current page directly from the toolbar popup: name (auto-filled from the domain), bar text, and a color picked from your swatches.
Wildcards are on by default (matches the whole site); turn them off to flag only the exact page.
New rules inherit all other settings from your default style.
Conflict check: if a rule already covers the page, the popup offers to edit it instead of creating a duplicate.
Confirmation with a bar preview and a one-click Edit rule that opens Settings expanded on the new rule.

sections.label: Added
items: Blur option that frosts the page behind the bar (available only when Bar Opacity is below 1; remembers its value when re-enabled).
Text Opacity option for the bar text.

sections.label: Changed
items: Renamed Background Color to Bar Color and Built-in Font to Font.
Reordered the Bar Appearance fields into a cleaner grid.
The bar always pushes page content down; removed the Page Placement option (it still overlays as the page scrolls).
Removed the redundant Oblique font style (identical to Italic).

sections.label: Changed
items: The changelog now reads from a single changelog.json file; the changelog page and the generated CHANGELOG.md both come from it.

sections.label: Added
items: Dedicated Changelog page, reachable from both Settings and Help.
A subtle Changelog link in the footer of the Settings and Help pages.

sections.label: Changed
items: The Settings Help button is now a lozenge, matching the Back buttons.
Simplified the Settings footer to just the version and Changelog link, matching the Help page footer.

sections.label: Changed
items: Global settings are now collapsible panels (Snooze, Default style, Domain blocklist, Display), matching the Rules accordion.
Each Global panel shows its current state in the summary.
Fixed cramped spacing in the Global section to match the Rules section.

sections.label: Fixed
items: The Default-style color picker no longer clips inside its collapsible panel.

sections.label: Added
items: Themed toolbar popup with an All sites master switch and a This page switch for the current tab's rule.
Global settings: master enable/disable, timed Snooze (1 hour / until tomorrow), default style for new rules, and a domain blocklist.

sections.label: Changed
items: Disabling globally remembers each rule's state; re-enabling restores it.
Per-page and global toggles are reflected on the matching rule switches.
Moved the bar layout mock-up toggle from Appearance into the Global section.

sections.label: Fixed
items: Reserved the scrollbar gutter so the column no longer shifts when a rule is expanded.
Aligned the Help page header with the Settings page for a seamless transition.

sections.label: Fixed
items: Help page now respects the theme set in Settings.
Help page Back button works again (moved inline scripts to an external file for MV3 compatibility).

sections.label: Added
items: Drag a text segment into any zone, and drag to reorder within a zone.
Toggle to show or hide the bar layout mock-up inside rules.

sections.label: Changed
items: Segment placement is now Left / Center / Right (removed Justify).

sections.label: Fixed
items: Zone labels no longer jump when a segment is placed.
Auto theme now follows the operating system correctly.

sections.label: Added
items: Light / Dark / Auto themes and a Chrome-native settings restyle.
Custom color picker with saved swatches for the Background and Text colors.
Fleet Server Info segment showing the server's version and branch, with an optional API token.
Multiple text segments per rule with independent placement, plus a drag-and-drop mock-up.
Extension version shown in the Help section.

sections.label: Baseline
items: Per-rule top bar with Domain Pattern and URL Components matching.
Per-rule text, style, height, and placement; collapsible rule list and in-extension help.
